title: A rubber sheet falls onto a ball and drapes

material.source: vulcanised natural rubber: shear modulus 0.42 MPa, the small-strain value of Ogden's (1972) fit to Treloar's (1944) tests; density 930 kg/m3, a typical natural rubber; a Kelvin-Voigt viscosity of 20 Pa s, which gives a loss factor of 0.1 at about 330 Hz (natural rubber's is 0.1 to 0.2 at audio frequencies): a demonstration value, not fitted to a test

note: Friction 0.8 is a typical dry value for rubber on a smooth hard surface; the damping of 1/s stands for the air and the rubber's own losses, not measured (demonstration values).
